title: KS-601: Is the Kintsugi dev / demo split done, so this ticket can close?
bluf: Kintsugi (dev) is up and takes develop deploys (latest recorded 2026-09-23); demo was 'unchanged' then. The runbook is merged (#943), the plan merged (#707). The original plan also said demo becomes demo+staging only, promoted to on your + Peter + Stuart go-ahead. You ruled on 2026-09-10 to deploy to both kintsugi and demo that week (grant expired 09-14), so the split was deliberately suspended once. Whether demo's role was flipped in docs/board and where deploys go today is unverified. Open children KS-1044/KS-1100 are in backlog (per triage).

sources.quote: Promotion gate: Kam + Peter + Stuart go-ahead, every promote
This ticket stays open on its own residue
Please deploy everything possible to kintsugi. Also deploy everything possible to demo
